title: Gym Habit Benefits
meta_desc: Discover the proven health benefits of a regular gym habit, from cardiovascular health to mental wellbeing, and learn how to get started with a gym membership in New Zealand.
intro: Regular exercise is essential for maintaining overall health and wellbeing. In New Zealand, where one in three adults suffer from obesity, incorporating a gym habit into your lifestyle can have numerous benefits. A gym membership can help you achieve your fitness goals, and with Exercise NZ's subsidised gym scheme, you can get 40-70% off your membership.

sections.heading: Introduction to Gym Habits
sections.body: A regular gym habit can have a significant impact on your overall health and wellbeing. Not only can it improve your cardiovascular health, but it can also boost your mental health and increase your longevity. According to research, regular exercise can reduce the risk of chronic diseases, such as heart disease and diabetes, by up to 35%. In New Zealand, where cardiovascular disease is a leading cause of death, incorporating a gym habit into your lifestyle can be particularly beneficial.

sections.heading: Cardiovascular Health Benefits
sections.body: Regular exercise is essential for maintaining a healthy heart. It can help lower blood pressure, improve circulation, and increase overall cardiovascular function. In fact, studies have shown that regular exercise can reduce the risk of heart disease by up to 21%. A gym membership can provide you with access to a range of cardiovascular equipment, such as treadmills and stationary bikes, to help you get started.

sections.heading: Mental Health and Weight Management Benefits
sections.body: A gym membership can provide you with access to a range of equipment and services to help you achieve your weight management goals, including personal training sessions and group fitness classes.

sections.heading: Getting Started with a Gym Membership
sections.body: If you're interested in starting a gym habit, there are a number of options available to you in New Zealand. With Exercise NZ's subsidised gym scheme, you can get 40-70% off your membership at a range of gyms across the country. To get started, simply visit the Exercise NZ website and enter your details to see if you're eligible for the scheme.
